attempts.summary: Built a three-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd pre-installed), loaded application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir, removed it from cluster membership via etcdctl from the surviving quorum), and replaced it with a fresh working member on the same node3 host using `member add` + `initial-cluster-state: existing`. Verified the cluster returned to 3 healthy members with identical raft-applied index and all original application keys intact. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed OS boot_id and full etcd/cluster/data recovery after each.
